governance: retrospective reproduction tolerances chosen with prior historical performance visible; NOT new confirmatory hypothesis limits
rule: Do not change after P1 results to obtain PASS. Numerical, physics and evaluation tolerance types separate.

tests.measure: SHA256 entire file vs locked sha256 for 39 canonical assets; FFD bank binaries vs bank receipt

tests.threshold: shape exactly (1303/922/1883,257,2,2) per case, dtype complex128; f count257 start6250400000 step1950000 exact
integer keys exact one-to-one; missing=0; duplicate=0

tests.measure: timeline chronological and sampled pose keys
tests.threshold: monotonic increasing, per timestamp equality max abs delta<=1e-9 s; no missing pose

tests.measure: sample xyz and yaw vs referenced timeline
tests.threshold: max |Delta x|,|Delta y| <=1e-6m; max wrapped |Delta yaw|<=1e-6 degree (CSV rounding allowance)

tests.measure: old z=[r,s] H->FFT->tap->r/s regenerated vs archived trace using SAME locked extractor
tests.threshold: first-path index identical; |delta r|<=1e-9 m and |delta s|<=1e-9 for every valid matched packet, no silent omission

tests.measure: same source/direct complex channel computed by independent algebra (within same source bank)
tests.threshold: relative complex max <=1e-10, excluding explicitly zero-power denominators which must STOP

tests.measure: SourceFFD direct complex H vs Native RT LoS Tx0 complex H, per-case and overall
tests.threshold: relative max<=5e-4; RMS<=1e-4; check common-phase correction not allowed

tests.measure: source predicted s vs NativeLoS observer s across all 9519 matching C0 points
tests.threshold: RMSE<=2e-6; max_abs<=2e-5; first-path tap mismatch=0; recorded prior benchmark already observed so only reproducibility test

tests.measure: central FD vs analytic J_s on stable source interpolation cell + tap + cap state
tests.threshold: abs<=2e-5 per m or rad OR rel<=1e-4 when |J|>1e-6; both report. At crossings do NOT FD-pass; tag boundary and count

tests.measure: old LUT observation/J same source reference
tests.threshold: abs<=1e-12 for identical numeric source and double math, on interior active cell; boundaries separately tagged

tests.measure: signed residual identity e_s_source-e_s_old == h_old-h_source and e_r_source==e_r_old
tests.threshold: max_abs s identity<=1e-10; r unchanged<=1e-12 m
min eigenvalue>=-1e-12 in prescribed [r(m),s(1)] numeric scale; exact symmetry max<1e-12; rows n<2 or singular=>report INSUFFICIENT never invert
finite and -1-1e-12<=s<=1+1e-12; total power>0; no silent clipping

tests.measure: full C0 case/pose and matched temporal populations
tests.threshold: Full9519 + LoS9519; 7251 timeline keys per channel; eval t>=30 gives6201 per channel; any exception logged no silent drop

tests.measure: raw numeric moment two independently coded formulas from same data
tests.threshold: sample mean abs difference<=1e-10 in each column native unit; covariance abs difference<=1e-9 in its numeric unit; same n and rejected row count

rationale.FD_limit: source piecewise changes at cell/tap boundaries; validity only on stable active cells

status_if_any_fails: FAIL and preserve evidence, no tolerance edit
scientific_claim_boundary: Deterministic/source reproducibility PASS alone is not publishable accuracy or independence evidence
